title: Crème Rosée 10oz Soy Candle
description:
Meet Crème Rosée, the very first candle from harly jae. Inspired by my favourite subtly flavoured ice cream from Afghan Kitchen—a blend of rose, cardamom, and cream—this candle captures that same delicate balance of comforting and fresh.

If I had my way entirely, it would have been an unscented beeswax candle (since most scented candles give me a headache), but I wanted to offer something special that even the most scent-sensitive among us could enjoy. The result? A clean-burning, subtly scented soy candle crafted with a thoughtful blend of essential oils and clean fragrance.

It's the perfect middle ground: never overwhelming, always inviting. Seasonless and sophisticated, Crème Rosée is designed to fill your space with a soft, comforting ambiance—a little slice of serenity, any time of year.

Light it, and let the warmth of rose, cardamom, and cream transport you to a moment of pure calm.

Details

  • 10oz Soy Candle, hand poured in Vancouver, BC.

title: Custom Length
description:
Customize the inseam of your harly jae bottoms! Please read this information carefully before ordering:

General Guidelines

  • To best establish the inseam length that you would like, measure from the crotch to the point on your leg that you would want the bottom of the hem to go to
  • Easier, measure the inseam on pants you love the length, add or remove a couple inches to that measurements to achieve the look desired 
  • It may take 2-3 weeks from your order date for us to ship your pants out, we will be in touch with you once you placed your order to give you an accurate timeline.
  • Some of our bottoms will shrink after the first wash. See details about this on each product listings to make sure you take this into consideration, or email us to make sure
  • On adding length : these bottoms are not "sewn to order" which means that we are adding a piece of fabric to the hem of the bottoms to make them longer by removing the original stitching which (from up-close) can leave some small needle holes on the pants. This usually becomes unnoticeable after a couple washes.
